title: Hazardous deep pothole near crossroad
description: Large deep pothole on the right lane near the 4th Avenue junction. Vehicles are swerving abruptly to avoid tyre damage, creating a serious collision risk during peak traffic hours.

title: Overflowing waste collection point
description: Commercial dustbins have been overflowing onto the sidewalk for three days. Debris and organic waste are spilling into the pedestrian pathway creating unpleasant odors and sanitation concerns.

title: Non-functional streetlights along residential avenue
description: Three consecutive streetlight fixtures along Elm Street are completely unlit after dark. The section is pitch black, posing a safety issue for evening pedestrians and cyclists.

title: Clogged stormwater drain causing street waterlogging
description: Main storm drain inlet is heavily choked with silt and plastic debris. Heavy waterlogging is submerging the curb and entering the adjacent bus stop bay.

title: Potable water pipeline leaking on main road
description: Clean municipal water is continuously pooling onto the asphalt from an underground pipe leak near the civic park gate. Water has been flowing steadily for over 12 hours.

title: Severe asphalt erosion and road shoulder collapse
description: Extensive road surface cracking and asphalt breakdown along the westbound transit corridor. Heavy vehicles have caused deep ruts and asphalt displacement.

title: Faded directional signage and bent speed warning post
description: The neighborhood school zone speed warning sign is bent at a 45-degree angle and the reflective coating has peeled off, reducing visibility for oncoming drivers.
